# bin

Executable entry point directory containing the `git-lanes` CLI script that bootstraps the command-line interface for the git-lanes tool.

## Contents

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [git-lanes](./git-lanes) | CLI executable script invoked when running `git-lanes` command |

## Entry Point Role

The `git-lanes` script in this directory is registered as the package binary via `package.json` `"bin"` field, enabling global or local installation and command-line invocation. This script delegates to the main CLI logic in [`src/cli.ts`](../src/cli.ts).

## Conventions

- Executable scripts in `bin/` have no file extension (standard Node.js/Bun convention for CLI binaries)
- The `git-lanes` script must be marked executable (`chmod +x`) for direct invocation
